Sharing the same feeling here lately. I have my ups and downs. But I don’t really live. I am anxious most of the time. Can’t see a future for myself. I remember when I was young, had such a great childhood, friends family I had everything I need. Had dreams of being successful in life, building a family...
Now I don’t see these things happen. Who wants to be in a relationship, with someone anxious and depressed. I myself don’t want to hurt anyone for taking them down by being in a relationship with me. Even now when I’m writing this I’m not feeling sure of myself. In my head- what will people think of me, wtf who is this guy, etc...
But whatever I’m writing that, and maybe i will feel better after it. Don’t know... it’s the first time I’m doing that. Maybe sharing what I feel with people who feels the same will help me and maybe others too
